identity: Nhal Veyr keeps the register of every Throng dead; outside its walls the Debtbound rise to collect debts nobody owes, and a mortuary clerk keeps a ledger of its own.

quests.title: [PH] The Account Is Closed
quests.text: [PH] Ossa Quietregister: Hush once worked at the shared register and kept working copies from that post (K11 A); he now enters our dead as debtors in the tombfields. End his collection. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] Ossa: the collection ends; the names stay, and his copies stay a question. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: The capital's named leader, alone: the local finale and one of chapter 2's prerequisites (T3).
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the id stays although its revenants are gone (plan §3: T3 requires it); free play, a level only, its one Throng follow-up is T3.

quests.title: [PH] Strike the False Claim
quests.text: [PH] Chapter 2 (T3, Strike the False Claim): Ossa has brought the findings together with Iven and the supply; the player posts the confirmed correction at the public register in front of the Miner's Guild house and reports to Iven Lastshift. No verdict of the player's own. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] Iven Lastshift: which claims are struck and why the original names stay; he keeps the true records for whoever comes with an old sheet later. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: Chapter 2's Throng close: a town place in the capital and the leader's turn-in.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: T3 (draft §5, K4 A); requires T2a, the free ossuary_rubbings_03 and nhal_veyr_vigil_03.
